note: ESP32-C3 Series Datasheet v2.4 (Espressif), chapter 5 Electrical Characteristics: Table 5-1 Absolute Maximum Ratings, Table 5-2, Table 5-4 DC Characteristics. 'evidence' quotes lines (a list = lines of one page, in order) of tests/corpus/excerpts/esp-esp32c3-dc.txt; 'page' is the 1-based PDF page. Relative values: rel = factor of VDD, rel_offset = VDD + offset; electrical.get() resolves them at VDD 3.3 V.

min.evidence: VDDA, VDD3P3, VDD3P3_RTC Recommended input voltage 3.0 3.3 3.6 V

max.evidence: VDDA, VDD3P3, VDD3P3_RTC Recommended input voltage 3.0 3.3 3.6 V

abs_max.evidence: Input power pins1 Allowed input voltage ⚶0.3 3.6 V
abs_max.conditions: Table 5-1 Absolute Maximum Ratings, allowed input voltage on the power pins (min -0.3 V)

vih.evidence: VIH High-level input voltage 0.75 × VDD1 — VDD1 + 0.3 V
vih.conditions: DC Characteristics table (3.3 V, 25 °C); VDD = I/O voltage of the pin's power domain; Min column

vil.evidence: VIL Low-level input voltage ⚶0.3 — 0.25 × VDD1 V
vil.conditions: DC Characteristics table (3.3 V, 25 °C); VDD = I/O voltage of the pin's power domain; Max column (Min -0.3 V)

voh.evidence: VOH 2 High-level output voltage 0.8 × VDD1 — — V
voh.conditions: DC Characteristics table (3.3 V, 25 °C); VDD = I/O voltage of the pin's power domain; measured with a high-impedance load; Min column

vol.evidence: VOL 2 Low-level output voltage — — 0.1 × VDD1 V
vol.conditions: DC Characteristics table (3.3 V, 25 °C); VDD = I/O voltage of the pin's power domain; measured with a high-impedance load; Max column

v_in_max.evidence: VIH High-level input voltage 0.75 × VDD1 — VDD1 + 0.3 V
v_in_max.conditions: DC Characteristics table (3.3 V, 25 °C); VDD = I/O voltage of the pin's power domain; VIH Max column (VDD + 0.3 V)

ioh.conditions: Typ column (no Min/Max in the datasheet); VDD = 3.3 V, VOH >= 2.64 V, maximum drive strength (PAD_DRIVER = 3); a capability figure, not a guaranteed limit

iol.conditions: Typ column (no Min/Max in the datasheet); VDD = 3.3 V, VOL = 0.495 V, maximum drive strength (PAD_DRIVER = 3); a capability figure, not a guaranteed limit

i_out_total_max.evidence: Ioutput 2 Cumulative IO output current — 1000 mA
i_out_total_max.conditions: Table 5-1 Absolute Maximum Ratings, cumulative IO output current (all pins together)

conditions: Table 5-4 DC Characteristics (3.3 V, 25 °C); VDD is the I/O voltage of the pin's power domain. IOH/IOL are typical values at maximum drive strength, not limits; the only current limit in the datasheet is the cumulative IO output current (absolute maximum).
